ValidationRule.description: Ensures the status only moves forward one step at a time (Pending ➔ Ready To Service ➔ Serviceable) and prevents skipping or reverting.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Ready To Service"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Pending")) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Serviceable"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Ready To Service")) ), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Pending") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status must progress sequentially: Pending ➔ Ready To Service ➔ Serviceable. You cannot skip steps or revert statuses backwards.
